Let me also verify the installer is now locked (re-running install.sh says already installed). And verify the config version. Let me quickly check that re-running install.sh exits with the "already installed" message.

Also I should verify the "install.pl" now locks. Let me run install.sh again to show it recognizes installed state.

Let me do a final couple checks and then report. Let me also verify Apache config symlink and that apache configtest passes.
